name: Physically based rendering
summary: A render model in which each material has measured albedo, roughness and metalness and conserves energy, so it looks right under any light.
how: Keep albedo in a physical range: about 30–240 sRGB for non-metals.
Set roughness and metalness from measured or scanned samples.
Light with physical units and a real sky; let light bounce.

origin.note: Brent Burley presents the Disney principled BRDF at SIGGRAPH.

adoptions.via: Brian Karis presents the Unreal Engine 4 shading model at SIGGRAPH; engines move to metal-roughness materials.

sources.title: Karis, Real Shading in Unreal Engine 4, SIGGRAPH 2013
